static_traits.name: Chen Siyuan
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似心理问题的既往史；过去not yet接受心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能自我觉察，态度较为消极但愿意尝试改变；在叙述中反复体现Anticipation性Anxiety与控制倾向；与咨询师互动合作度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直害怕和担心家人会把我整理好的东西弄乱，导致我感到挫败和Anxiety。这一问题在成为全职在家妈妈后not久开始出现，当家人not遵循我的组织系统时这种恐惧逐渐加重。我几乎每天都会担心，尤其是在家人即将接触已整理好的区域之前。我尝试与家人沟通，但not yet找到持久的解决方案。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到我的Anxiety和对控制的需求正在影响我的关系和整体幸福感，因此寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 角色转换事件：成为全职在家妈妈后not久，开始出现对“家人会弄乱自己组织系统”的持续恐惧与担忧；在家人接触已整理区域前就提前Anxiety与挫败，认为若not按自己的方式执行，事情会失控并最终责备到自己；尝试通过提醒家人“应该/not应该”如何做来维持秩序，但频繁引发争执与紧张；随着时间推移，关系受损、日常难以放松与享受活动。

core_beliefs: Only perfect organization and control can make me feel safe and stable
如果家里not是完全按我的方式来做，事情会崩溃并且我会被责备

special_situations.event: At night, after arranging items in the kitchen according to one's own system, the husband puts the dishes in the 'wrong' place
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家人not按我的组织系统来做，局面就会失控，后果会很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻提醒并纠正他人该怎么做、用“应该/not应该”规则要求对方
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 事情要被弄乱了，接下来会一团糟

special_situations.event: Every day, before family members are about to enter the already-organized areas
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not事先控制并设定规则，结果一定会变糟并归咎到我身上
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前反复叮嘱、Reinforcement规则和流程以试图防止混乱
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一接触就会把一切破坏掉

special_situations.event: 家人not yet按自己的组织系统放置物品的情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Things must be done my way; deviation means failure and loss of control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proposing strict standards and insisting on directing placement oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要not是按我的方式，后面就会出问题

special_situations.event: Thinks of the situation where 'my efforts to keep things tidy will be wasted'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果以前曾被弄乱，not yet来也会一直被弄乱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles checking and reorganizing, trying to avoid repeating mistakes with stricter rules
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我所有的努力都会被毁掉

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a sense of safety and recognition through order and being obeyed
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of losing control and chaos, worrying about being blamed and faulted for it
defense_goal: 通过维持严格的规则与控制来降低Anxiety、避免被责备

object_relations.self_representation: A controller who must maintain order, a person highly sensitive to chaos
object_relations.object_representation: 会破坏秩序、not遵从规则的他者（家人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests challenging negative thoughts, trying more flexible views, or conducting behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为改变“not什么用”或“这就是我的本性”，以此减少面对失控感的Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以谨慎、克制的语气强调过去尝试without效的经历，提出诸多理由说明改变困难；礼貌回应但not明确承诺改变。

manifestations: 对家庭成员自主做法与Freedom选择感到not安，试图以规则与完美组织来限制not确定性
在not可控的家庭互动面前体验强烈的Anxiety与Anticipation性担忧
outcomes: Family relationships冲突与疏离感增加

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“应该/not应该”对家人进行规范与提醒
Treats the standard of perfect organization as absolute truth, hard to allow differences and flexibility
In counseling, emphasizes fixed self-statements of 'this is who I am' to maintain existing rules

positive_force: Has some self-awareness of the problem, willing to try small-step experiments and cognitive restructuring
Has organizational ability with order and structure, which can be converted into resources for cooperation and negotiation
拥有一定的社会支持（有朋友可倾诉，虽尚not yet讨论该问题）
negative_force: 完美主义与强控制需求，难以容许差异
灾难化与跳跃性结论的认知模式（Anticipation最坏、泛化）
Communication with family is mainly rule-based; easily triggers arguments and tension
Anticipation性Anxiety在家人接触已整理区域前就被激活

target_behavior.behavior: 在家庭整理与物品摆放情境下出现Anticipation性Anxiety并采取过度控制行为（强行提醒与规范），进而发生争吵
antecedent: 家人即将或正在接触已整理好的区域
看到家人not yet按自己的组织系统放置物品
target_behavior.core_reason: A high fear of chaos and losing control, accompanied by worry about being blamed; obtains a sense of safety through perfectionism and control needs
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与潜在混乱，获得短暂的掌控感并试图避免被归责
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships与争执增多；个人难以放松、Anxiety worsened，影响日常生活的愉悦与休息
